messages:
anya: Quick sync notes from partner call this morning. We need to align on staggered GA/marketplace timelines for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. High-level ask: avoid cross-region surge, give SIs time for dry-run, and respect partner embargo windows.

mike: Capacity model suggests region-staggered GA reduces peak traffic by ~42%. Ops needs two-week lead for kernel/image bake and push.

jordan: Recommend marketplace soft-listing 48h after partner press embargo lifts. Partners are OK with 48-72h buffer but some prefer same-day listing if private embargo.

rachel: Marketing wants a single "announce choreography" doc per vendor. Need final messaging by May 1 for partners that want early May announces.

suresh: Heads-up: Gaudi firmware gating might slip into late May for a subset of SKUs. If that happens, cert completion slides ~10 days. Partners asked if they can send signed firmware earlier.

natasha: From SI side: we need a scheduled dry-run week with reserved nodes and access to marketplace staging images. Can we reserve Apr 28-May 2?

mike: Ops: lab maintenance Apr 25-26. Apr 28-May 2 looks doable if we freeze unrelated CI. We'll prioritize SI dry-run.

anya: Actionable plan proposal: H100 region-limited GA early May, MI300 mid-May, Gaudi end of May. Marketplace soft-list 48h after embargo; SLA start = marketplace active +7d. SI dry-run = week before each regional GA window.

jordan: Also flag a runtime packaging risk for H200 quantized builds needing an updated runtime ABI. Need runtime team to run packaging smoke tests on Apr 22.

suresh: I'll queue the runtime smoke test Apr 22. If it fails, options: delay H200 region or push interim runtime-compatible image.

mike: I'll create the partnership tracker doc and add owners, GA windows, marketplace soft-listing dates, SI dry-run slots, firmware signoff owners, and press cutoff times.

rachel: Once mike shares tracker link, I'll add PR owners and embargo language. Partners asked for a public-facing marketplace availability table.

anya: Summary actions: mike -> create tracker & calendar invites; suresh -> runtime smoke test Apr 22 + confirm lab reserve Apr 28-May 2; jordan -> SI dry-run checklist; rachel -> PR messaging draft by May 1; natasha -> confirm SI team headcount for dry-run.

deploy-bot: build-notify: queued marketplace-image-build h100-beta (id: bld-8827).

mike: added initial calendar invites. Partners asked for a final go/no-go cutoff 72h before each regional GA.

anya: Good. We'll reconvene Wed after partner confirmations. :thumbsup:
